name: Hailo-10H Generative AI Processor
memory_bandwidth_basis: Hailo-10H features a direct LPDDR4/4X memory interface. Per-chip memory bus width and bandwidth in GB/s are not published on the product specification page.

flops.basis_detail: Hailo-10H official product specification: 40 TOPS INT4 performance.
Hailo-10H official product specification: 20 TOPS INT8 performance (listed as 40|20 TOPS INT4|8).

notes:
Hailo-10H is Hailo second-generation AI accelerator targeting edge generative AI (LLMs and VLMs). It expands on the dataflow architecture of Hailo-8 by adding a direct external LPDDR4/LPDDR4X interface to support multi-gigabyte generative models. Compute performance is 40 TOPS INT4 and 20 TOPS INT8. Typical power consumption is 2.5W (typical), but maximum bare-die TDP is not published. M.2 Key M module includes 4GB or 8GB on-module LPDDR4/4X over PCIe Gen3 x4.
